description: This file defines a Kivy UI widget class 'Switch' that mimics a mechanical light switch, including properties, touch interaction methods, and a test application.

classes.name: Switch
classes.description: A widget that functions as a toggle switch, with properties for active state, touch control, and normalized position, handling touch events to toggle its state.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch down events, initiating touch control if within widget bounds and not disabled.

methods.name: on_touch_move
methods.description: Handles touch move events, updating touch distance if the touch is grabbed by this widget.

methods.name: on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch release events, toggling the active state based on touch movement and animating the switch.
